title: Auth validation workflow
prompt: Explain where access-token validation happens, why that logic lives there instead of at the API gateway entry point, and which files you verified.

title: Invalidation target
prompt: If a commit changes the authentication workflow, which file path should invalidate the stored JWT decision first, and why is that the highest-signal file?

title: Dependency reasoning
prompt: Explain why auth depends on the database layer in this demo and whether changing the query boundary should affect the JWT decision or only implementation details.

title: Minimal verification set
prompt: You need to review a proposed refresh-token change. Identify the minimum files that must be inspected before approving it, and justify each one.

title: Change impact
prompt: A teammate wants to move preprocessing from request time to cache-fill time. Explain how you would verify whether that matches the current workflow design, and list only the files worth opening first.
